agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py _process_identifierlist: replaced stale cached token.value reads with dynamic str(token) calls for wrap-position length calculations (3 occurrences), since TokenList.value caching introduced by a recent performance fix wasn't being kept in sync when nested groups (e.g. Function calls) are mutated during bottom-up reindent processing. This restores correct wrapping behavior for long identifier lists containing function calls.
